templates.label: Postgraduate student appraisal form
templates.totalLabel: 15 elements, rated 1–9 each. The NMC form prints no total.
templates.sourceTitle: NMC MD General Medicine (revised 2022), Annexure 1 — Student appraisal form. The same form appears in the other 2022-revised guidelines.

criteria.label: 1.1  Has Knowledge appropriate for level of training
1.2  Participation and contribution to learning activity (e.g., Journal Club, Seminars, CME etc)
1.3  Conduct of research and other scholarly activity assigned (e.g. Posters, publications etc)
1.4  Documentation of acquisition of competence (eg Log book)
2.1  Ability to provide patient care appropriate to level of training
2.2  Ability to work with other members of the health care team
2.3  Ability to communicate appropriately and empathetically with patients, families and care givers
2.4  Ability to do procedures appropriate for the level of training and assigned role
2.5  Ability to record and document work accurately and appropriate for level of training
2.6  Participation and contribution to health care quality improvement
3.2  Contribution to growth of learning of the team
3.3  Conduct that is ethical, appropriate and respectful at all times

templates.discussedLabel: 5  Disposition — Has this assessment been discussed with the trainee?
templates.signatureLabel: Name and Signature of the assessor
templates.note: requireDiscussed is true because the form itself asks the question. pglog-model.assess() throws if it is left unanswered. noTotal is true because Annexure 1 is a banded per-element rating with a comments column and NO total row. Synthesising '105 / 135' on a document an examiner may see would be a mark the NMC form does not have. (R1 finding I5.)

templates.label: Academic activity assessment
templates.sourceTitle: INSTITUTIONAL. The NMC curricula require academic presentations to be graded ('The presenter(s) shall be assessed by faculty and grades recorded in the logbook' — MD General Medicine, Journal club) but print no rubric. These criteria are StewardMD's default and are editable by the Academic Cell. They are NOT an NMC form.

templates.label: Thesis / research progress review
templates.sourceTitle: INSTITUTIONAL. NMC requires thesis-related research (PGMER-2023 2.2(iii)) and MD Emergency Medicine lists 'Thesis review Presentation & performance' as an academic activity, but no NMC rubric is printed. Editable by the Academic Cell.
